title: TrailerCraft
description: Make Minecraft look just like the Trailers! - Now with Vibrant Visuals!
body:
# 🎥 TrailerCraft 

Have you wanted to make your Minecraft look like it does in the Trailers?

There you go: The **best** Trailer Modpack **with support for 26.1.2 Version + Vibrant Visuals on Java! 🔥**

## List of important Keybinds

- **F2** - Take a Screeenshot in 4k resolution
- **K** - Toggle Vibrant Visuals
- **F4** - Toggle Freecam

> _If you want the ugly Trailer Leaves you need to disable the BetterLeaves ressource pack!_

## FaQ


<details>
<summary>I hate the Animations. How to disable them?</summary>

Just disable the following ressource packs:
- FreshAnimations
- FreshAnimations x BareBones
- FreshMoves

</details>

<details>
<summary>How to use Flashback?</summary>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/XPBwuC97_-w" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Why is it so laggy?</summary>

Sadly, the Shader is kinda badly optimized. If you render the footage with Flashback though, it will be smooth.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Will there ever be support for other Modloaders?</summary>

No

</details>



**⚠️ This Modpack contains Mods that are considered cheating by some servers. Use at your own risk!**
